2. The Chief Clinical Dietitian strongly advocates transitioning immediately to Enteral Nutrition via a Nasojejunal (NJ) feeding tube, emphasizing the clinical dictum: 'If the gut works, even partially, use it!'

Prealbumin has a rapid half-life of 2-3 days, making it an agile, responsive biomarker for tracking acute nutritional changes and recovery in ICU patients.
